question: Should OpenClaw resolve this by converging to one recommended memory backend/config surface, adopting the multi-slot memory role architecture, or keeping the current split model with stronger diagnostics and docs?
rationale: The request touches public config, plugin-slot API, storage defaults, QMD/builtin behavior, and doctor migration semantics, and current main plus PR #88504 show multiple plausible product directions that automation should not choose.

options.title: Sponsor a canonical memory architecture decision
options.body: Use this issue together with #60572 and PR #88504 to choose the durable config, role, and migration path before implementation.

options.title: Keep the split model intentionally
options.body: Close or narrow this only after maintainers decide that separate backend, search, flush, and plugin-slot controls are intentional and diagnostics/docs should carry the UX burden.

options.title: Define a smaller config consolidation
options.body: Reject the full role-slot direction for now and create a narrower preset or doctor/setup flow that maps onto existing config without changing plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a canonical memory architecture decision
recommendation.body: Use this issue together with #60572 and PR #88504 to choose the durable config, role, and migration path before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is public product/config/API direction, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the project decision owner.
